questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'benevolent'?
explanation: Charitable is a synonym for benevolent - C-H-A-R-I-T-A-B-L-E. Both mean generous and kind.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'verbose'?
explanation: Concise is the antonym of verbose - C-O-N-C-I-S-E. Verbose means using too many words; concise means brief.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'tenacious'?
explanation: Persistent is a synonym for tenacious - P-E-R-S-I-S-T-E-N-T. Both mean determined and not giving up.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'exacerbate'?
explanation: Alleviate is the antonym of exacerbate - A-L-L-E-V-I-A-T-E. Exacerbate means to make worse; alleviate means to lessen.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'candid'?
explanation: Forthright is a synonym for candid - F-O-R-T-H-R-I-G-H-T. Both mean honest and direct.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'frugal'?
explanation: Extravagant is the antonym of frugal - E-X-T-R-A-V-A-G-A-N-T. Frugal means careful with money; extravagant means spending too much.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'repudiate'?
explanation: Reject is a synonym for repudiate - R-E-J-E-C-T. Repudiate means to refuse to accept or be associated with something.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'loquacious'?
explanation: Taciturn is the antonym of loquacious - T-A-C-I-T-U-R-N. Loquacious means very talkative; taciturn means habitually silent.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'dilapidated'?
explanation: Decrepit is a synonym for dilapidated - D-E-C-R-E-P-I-T. Both describe something in a state of disrepair.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'vindictive'?
explanation: Forgiving is the antonym of vindictive - F-O-R-G-I-V-I-N-G. Vindictive means seeking revenge; forgiving means merciful.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'opulent'?
explanation: Lavish is a synonym for opulent - L-A-V-I-S-H. Both describe great wealth or luxury.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'ephemeral'?
explanation: Permanent is the antonym of ephemeral - P-E-R-M-A-N-E-N-T. Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'enigmatic'?
explanation: Mysterious is a synonym for enigmatic - M-Y-S-T-E-R-I-O-U-S. Both describe something difficult to understand.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'adept'?
explanation: Incompetent is the antonym of adept - I-N-C-O-M-P-E-T-E-N-T. Adept means highly skilled; incompetent means lacking skill.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'clandestine'?
explanation: Covert is a synonym for clandestine - C-O-V-E-R-T. Both mean done secretly.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'benign'?
explanation: Malignant is the antonym of benign - M-A-L-I-G-N-A-N-T. Benign means harmless; malignant means harmful or life-threatening.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'nefarious'?
explanation: Wicked is a synonym for nefarious - W-I-C-K-E-D. Nefarious means criminal and wicked.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'tumultuous'?
explanation: Tranquil is the antonym of tumultuous - T-R-A-N-Q-U-I-L. Tumultuous means loud and chaotic; tranquil means calm.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'salubrious'?
explanation: Healthful is a synonym for salubrious - H-E-A-L-T-H-F-U-L. Salubrious means promoting health and wellbeing.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'gregarious'?
explanation: Solitary is the antonym of gregarious - S-O-L-I-T-A-R-Y. Gregarious means fond of company; solitary means alone.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'pernicious'?
explanation: Harmful is a synonym for pernicious - H-A-R-M-F-U-L. Pernicious means having a harmful effect, especially gradually.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'obsequious'?
explanation: Assertive is the antonym of obsequious - A-S-S-E-R-T-I-V-E. Obsequious means too eager to serve; assertive means self-confident.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'magnanimous'?
explanation: Generous is a synonym for magnanimous - G-E-N-E-R-O-U-S. Both mean noble and giving in spirit.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'vociferous'?
explanation: Quiet is the antonym of vociferous - Q-U-I-E-T. Vociferous means making a loud outcry; quiet means making little noise.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'alacrity'?
explanation: Eagerness is a synonym for alacrity - E-A-G-E-R-N-E-S-S. Alacrity means cheerful readiness and enthusiasm.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'lucid'?
explanation: Obscure is the antonym of lucid - O-B-S-C-U-R-E. Lucid means clear and easy to understand; obscure means unclear.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'spurious'?
explanation: Counterfeit is a synonym for spurious - C-O-U-N-T-E-R-F-E-I-T. Spurious means not genuine or true.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'dexterous'?
explanation: Clumsy is the antonym of dexterous - C-L-U-M-S-Y. Dexterous means skilled; clumsy means awkward.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'lethargic'?
explanation: Sluggish is a synonym for lethargic - S-L-U-G-G-I-S-H. Both mean lacking energy or enthusiasm.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'prodigal'?
explanation: Thrifty is the antonym of prodigal - T-H-R-I-F-T-Y. Prodigal means spending money recklessly; thrifty means careful with money.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'querulous'?
explanation: Complaining is a synonym for querulous - C-O-M-P-L-A-I-N-I-N-G. Querulous means habitually whining.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'intrepid'?
explanation: Timid is the antonym of intrepid - T-I-M-I-D. Intrepid means fearless; timid means showing lack of courage.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'meager'?
explanation: Scanty is a synonym for meager - S-C-A-N-T-Y. Both mean lacking in quantity or quality.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'amiable'?
explanation: Hostile is the antonym of amiable - H-O-S-T-I-L-E. Amiable means friendly; hostile means unfriendly.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'obstinate'?
explanation: Stubborn is a synonym for obstinate - S-T-U-B-B-O-R-N. Both mean refusing to change one's opinion.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'terse'?
explanation: Verbose is the antonym of terse - V-E-R-B-O-S-E. Terse means brief and to the point; verbose means using too many words.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'indolent'?
explanation: Lazy is a synonym for indolent - L-A-Z-Y. Indolent means wanting to avoid activity or exertion.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'prudent'?
explanation: Reckless is the antonym of prudent - R-E-C-K-L-E-S-S. Prudent means acting with wisdom; reckless means without thought.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'acrimony'?
explanation: Bitterness is a synonym for acrimony - B-I-T-T-E-R-N-E-S-S. Acrimony means angry and bitter feelings.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'flamboyant'?
explanation: Understated is the antonym of flamboyant - U-N-D-E-R-S-T-A-T-E-D. Flamboyant means very showy; understated means subtle.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'zealous'?
explanation: Fervent is a synonym for zealous - F-E-R-V-E-N-T. Both mean having great energy or enthusiasm.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'destitute'?
explanation: Affluent is the antonym of destitute - A-F-F-L-U-E-N-T. Destitute means very poor; affluent means wealthy.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'tacit'?
explanation: Implied is a synonym for tacit - I-M-P-L-I-E-D. Tacit means understood without being stated.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'pedantic'?
explanation: Practical is the antonym of pedantic - P-R-A-C-T-I-C-A-L. Pedantic means overly concerned with rules; practical means focused on usefulness.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'ubiquitous'?
explanation: Omnipresent is a synonym for ubiquitous - O-M-N-I-P-R-E-S-E-N-T. Both mean present everywhere at the same time.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'erudite'?
explanation: Ignorant is the antonym of erudite - I-G-N-O-R-A-N-T. Erudite means having great knowledge; ignorant means lacking knowledge.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'impetuous'?
explanation: Impulsive is a synonym for impetuous - I-M-P-U-L-S-I-V-E. Both mean acting quickly without thinking.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'serene'?
explanation: Agitated is the antonym of serene - A-G-I-T-A-T-E-D. Serene means calm; agitated means troubled or anxious.

questionText: Which word is a SYNONYM for 'acrimonious'?
explanation: Bitter is a synonym for acrimonious - B-I-T-T-E-R. Acrimonious means angry and full of bitterness.

questionText: Which word is an ANTONYM for 'candid'?
explanation: Evasive is the antonym of candid - E-V-A-S-I-V-E. Candid means truthful and straightforward; evasive means avoiding directness.
